description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Dispute between National Savings Bank Colombo 3 and other part executive Officers Association of the National Savings Bank
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between the National Savings Bank and the Executive Officers' Association under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, and working conditions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for employment matters.
